Our hardworking congressional staff deserve a union fighting for their wages, working conditions, health care, and retirement.

Efforts to exercise their right to unionize have my full support.

The pandemic has worsened food insecurity among college students. We need to ensure every student is informed about access to critical nutrition benefits.

I joined my colleagues in a letter urging @USDA @SecVilsack to clarify SNAP eligibility to meet expanded student needs. https://t.co/R7WHWsFxHQ

The $$ passed in the House today will:

✅Protect & Preserve Public Lands and Biodiversity
✅Tackle Hunger & Nutrition Insecurity
✅Confront the Climate Crisis
✅Support Our Veterans

#ForOurCommunity #CommunityProjectFunding

Learn more: https://t.co/pqqtpNeqJt https://t.co/o9rf7TtYu2

📢GRANT ALERT! @NSHE @unlv has received $150,000 from @HHSGov for HIV capacity development and planning. This will be led by Dr. David Di John, Medical Director of the UNLV Health Maternal-Child Wellness Program.
Today @POTUS convened the White House Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health. We must tackle these issues and end diet-related illness in the U.S.

Today is #NationalDepressionScreeningDay. Depression can cause:
🛌Changes in sleep
🍎Changes in appetite
🔋Loss of energy
🙅Lack of interest in activities
💭Suicidal thoughts

If these are happening to you, take a screener and get help: https://t.co/RyFL6C94fO. You are #NotAlone.

📢GRANT ALERT! @TheJusticeDept has awarded Sunrise Health Clinics $750,000 for the Family First program which rehabilitates families in the court system with daily classes, wellness, family therapy, and supervised home interventions.

Imagine passing billions in tax cuts for the wealthy, then pushing to cut nutrition support for families in need.

That’s the reality in a Republican Congress, and it’s unacceptable. We need to #DefendSNAP.

https://t.co/MRr4j1qCko

Just as our first responders take care of us, we need to take care of them. 

I was proud to secure federal funding to help @cityofhenderson’s Wellness Center expansion move forward and provide vital mental health services for our community’s heroes. https://t.co/pkRYE8K9N5

The Leukemia and Lymphoma Society is a leading voice in the fight against blood cancer. It was a pleasure to meet with @LLSUSA Las Vegas to discuss the importance of broadening treatment choices and reducing healthcare expenses for patients. https://t.co/V83iIdN7hd

What an honor to receive the Freedom Award from @FreeWildHorses for my commitment to protecting wild horses. 

I will continue to advance legislation to ensure humane treatment and explore innovative solutions to preserve these icons of the West. https://t.co/LPV1xMgEbB

Last year, we passed the #InflationReductionAct into law, capping insulin costs at $35 for seniors on Medicare.
 
Nearly 10% of adults in Nevada have been diagnosed with diabetes and I will continue fighting for this treatment to be affordable for everyone. #WorldDiabetesDay
Happy #InternationalAnimalRightsDay! As a member of the Congressional Animal Protection Caucus, I will always fight for the protection and humane treatment of all animals. @HumaneSociety @AWIOnline

I joined a bipartisan group of lawmakers to urge the inclusion of VA medical marijuana provisions in the Veterans Bill.

This provision will allow @DeptVetAffairs doctors to issue medical marijuana to veterans living in states where the treatment is legal.

#TeamTitus attended the grand opening of the Veterinary Emergency Group in Henderson.

As an advocate for the humane treatment of all animals, I welcome this new resource for local pet owners. #OnlyInDistrictOne https://t.co/10ROZzQasn

I’m proud to receive a 100+% rating from @HSLegFund on their 2023 Humane Scorecard.
 
As a lifelong advocate for the humane treatment of all animals, I look forward to continuing this important work. #HumaneScorecard https://t.co/fc6yGk0BPq

.@BLMNational persists in ignoring Congressional directives regarding the humane treatment of wild horses. This must stop.
 
Today I sent the letter below urging them to reconsider their FY24 Tentative Wild Horse and Burro Gather and Fertility Control Schedule: https://t.co/Rtw5f5Ji7A

I secured $782,000 in last week's funding bill for the @CityofHenderson’s Public Safety Officer Mental Health & Wellness Program.

This project will support law enforcement officers experiencing PTSD, depression, anxiety, and other mental health disorders. https://t.co/APCz1dbNe5

The Henderson Health and Wellness Center is an important resource for hardworking public servants.
 
I proudly secured funding for the center which will establish a positive framework to treat trauma, anxiety, depression, and thoughts of suicide. https://t.co/uVhpulq3Tl

Today I met with advocates about my bill, the Wild Horse and Burro Protection Act.
 
I am proud to lead efforts in Congress to protect these icons of the West from inhumane treatment and death. https://t.co/IrGhBp16Ud

This #MentalHealthAwarenessMonth, I’m proud to cosponsor @RepGwenMoore’s Mental Health & MAMA Act to improve access to mental health care and substance abuse treatment for pregnant women and new mothers.

I’m proud to have worked with @PHCCNATL to ensure FEMA gives equal treatment to codes utilized by Nevada plumbing and HVAC professionals so we are able to continue preparing for future emergencies. https://t.co/kus0sNSf94

Republican proposals to slash future SNAP benefits in the Farm Bill are not only irresponsible, but will also cause thousands of families to go hungry.

I will continue to fight for the half million Nevadans who rely on this critical food nutrition program.

Last week, the @DeptVetAffairs announced $8.5 million in grant funding to @USVETSLV and @SalArmySONV to help homeless veterans and their families with housing solutions. No veteran should sleep on the streets.

I am partnering with @RepMolinaroNY19 to confront the opioid and fentanyl crisis head-on. Our new bill, the Fentanyl Seizure and Health Recovery Act, would use existing federal law to provide more funding for substance use treatment and prevention. #EndOverdose
